episodes.title: #232 Bernard Jackman // High Performance in Rugby, Coaching & Beyond
episodes.description:
On episode 232 I am joined by Bernard Jackman, a former professional rugby player, coach, and now a performance consultant, guest speaker and respected voice in Irish sport. 
Bernard is a former pro Rugby player who played for Connacht, Leinster, Sale Sharks and an Irish international. He has been head coach in FC Grenoble, France and at the Dragons in Wales. Bernard is one of only a small number of Irish rugby players to have won a Six Nations, European Cup, Challenge Cup and a Magners League Medal.
Since retiring from professional rugby he has moved into coaching and high-performance leadership. Bernard has built a diverse career across coaching, media, athlete development and performance consultancy, working with teams and organisations both within and beyond rugby. His work has also extended into other sporting environments, including collaborations with Horse Sport Ireland and involvement around the 2024 Paris Olympic Games. 
Jackman grew up on the Wicklow/Carlow border he grew up on a cattle farm which led to a different path to elite sport. We discuss how this affected his career and upbringing. Bernard shares his advice to parents with children on the elite sporting pathway and also offered insights to current athletes on developing their professional development and working during their sporting career. 
A major part of Bernard’s professional development came through his master’s research, where he travelled across the world studying some of the leading high-performance teams and organisations in sport including Manchester United, Dyson, Sydney Swans, Toyota, Melbourne Storm, Just Eat and more. Through visiting elite environments and learning directly from coaches, athletes and performance leaders, he gained valuable insight into the habits, cultures and systems that underpin sustained success at the highest level.
In this episode, we discuss Bernard’s journey through professional sport, working with Enda NcNulty, learning from Alex Ferguson, Brian O’Driscoll and Jonny Sexton, his approach to retirement, transitioning into coaching, high-performance environments, and the lessons he has taken from working across multiple sports. 
The conversation also explores performance, elite sport, and what high performance really looks like behind the scenes in sport & business.

episodes.title: Bernard Jackman - High Performance In Sport & Business #32
episodes.description:
Bernard Jackman joins the podcast to share a fascinating journey from elite rugby to high-performance leadership in business. The former Bernard Jackman reflects on the lessons learned throughout a career that took him from Connacht and Leinster to the Sale Sharks and the Irish national team.

He opens up about the demands of professional rugby, the culture inside elite dressing rooms, and what separates good teams from truly great ones. Drawing on stories from his playing days, Bernard discusses resilience, leadership under pressure, adapting to setbacks, and the importance of standards and accountability in high-performance environments.

The conversation also explores his coaching experiences in France and Wales, where he gained a deeper understanding of different rugby cultures, leadership styles, and how successful organisations build winning mindsets. Bernard explains how those experiences shaped his own philosophy around team development and performance.

Away from rugby, Bernard now works closely with business leaders and organisations, helping companies apply elite sporting principles to the workplace. He discusses how communication, trust, culture, and clarity of purpose are just as important in business as they are in professional sport. From boardrooms to dressing rooms, he explains why sustainable high performance always comes back to people.

The episode also provides insight into his growing media career and keynote speaking work, where he shares practical lessons on leadership, teamwork, and performance with audiences across sport and business.

This is an engaging discussion packed with stories from professional rugby, honest reflections on leadership, and valuable insights for anyone interested in performance, culture, and building successful teams.

episodes.description:
Podcast Episode with Bernard Jackman | High Performance, Team Culture & Resilience

Bernard Jackman is a former Irish international rugby player, coach, and high-performance consultant whose story of success, setbacks, and resilience makes him an inspiring and engaging speaker. From his early rugby career with Connacht, Sale Sharks, and Leinster — winning European and Six Nations titles — to coaching at Grenoble and the Dragons, Bernard has lived through the highs and lows of elite sport.

After retiring, he transitioned into leadership consulting, guiding some of the world’s top companies on creating high-performance cultures built on trust, accountability, and teamwork. Alongside his corporate work, he is a respected rugby pundit with RTE, The 42, and the Sunday Independent, and currently serves as Head of High Performance at Horse Sport Ireland, preparing athletes for the Paris 2024 Olympics and Paralympics.

Bernard believes true success comes from people engagement, buy-in, and a shared purpose — lessons we can all apply, whether in sport, business, or life.

🎙️ About the Host – Doug Gordon

Doug D Gordon is an international keynote speaker, executive coach, bestselling author, national radio presenter, award-winning healer, and former C-level executive in finance. He specializes in leadership, performance optimization, sales, emotional intelligence, resilience, and communication. Doug has spoken for FTSE 100 and Fortune 500 companies, featured in The Times and The Independent, and hosts this podcast bringing you conversations with some of the most inspirational people in the world.

episodes.title: Bold Predictions and Sharp Analysis: The Road to the Rugby World Cup Final with Bernard Jackman
episodes.description:
Ready to get a dose of heart-stopping match analysis and bold predictions for the Rugby World Cup Final? Join us as we dissect the exhilarating semi-finals, where the All Blacks demonstrated their sheer dominance even with fourteen men, and Argentina cleverly optimised their bench. We'll celebrate the exceptional performances of the All Blacks' Richie, Moongah, Smith and their back row, while applauding the hat trick hero, Will Jordan. But our analysis doesn't stop there. We'll critique Mark Talaea's deft break tackles and the strategy South Africa will need to counter them. Plus, we'll be deciphering England's successful tactics against South Africa, their spot-on contestable kicks and how they levelled with the might of the Bok pack.

The world of rugby is ever-evolving, and we're on top of it. Could the English rugby team see a shake-up after their semi-finals loss? We're pondering over that and squaring in on how the scrum - a game for all shapes and sizes - might be the key differentiator. The South African bench has been a game-changer in recent matches, and we're assessing their impact. What about the All Blacks' prowess to stand up against South Africa's powerful scrum, especially with the ever-changing weather as a wildcard? We've got that covered too. And as we gaze into our crystal ball for the Rugby World Cup Final, we're foreseeing a gripping showdown between South Africa and France. Stay tuned to hear why the Boks should be expected to win by four or five points. Buckle up for an episode brimming with incisive analysis and daring forecasts!

episodes.title: Breaking Down Ireland's Rugby World Cup Team Choices with Bernard Jackman
episodes.description:
You’re about to get a deep dive analysis of Ireland’s Rugby World Cup squad announcement, we're not holding back! I’m your host and together we'll unravel the logic behind the tough decisions made in selecting the final roster, the stand-by players who are on the brink of game time, and the reasons why five talented contenders didn't make the cut. The injury of the irreplaceable Keane Healy and its ramifications on the squad’s depth will be laid out bare. Plus, we’ll take you through the thrilling Samoa match, dissecting the good, the bad, and the brilliant problem-solving strategies adopted by the coaching staff at half time.

We’re turning up the heat, discussing not only the selection but the electrifying anticipation that surrounds the World Cup. Find out why Keith Earl's leadership made him an indispensable asset and why Keane Prendegast, despite his talents, didn't make it through. As we look forward to the Arlim Romani game - the match to kick-start the World Cup on Friday week - we'll give you insider insights into what to expect from the opening weekend. episodes.title: Rugby World Cup 2023 - Ireland's Chances Explored with Bernard Jackman
episodes.description:
Are you ready to get a comprehensive look at the world of rugby in anticipation of the upcoming World Cup? Join us and our esteemed guest, former pro rugby player and coach, Bernard Jackman, as we break down everything you need to know about Ireland's chances. We cover everything - from Keith Earls' impressive 100th cap, Ireland's current form, and potential stumbling blocks in their group, to the crucial role of Dan Sheen and the possible impact of Roland Keller's fitness. And let's not forget the formidable South Africa team - the reigning World Champions. We take a deep dive into the importance of conditioning in rugby and predict how these factors could all play out on the world stage.

But that's not all! We also explore some potential surprises in the World Cup - the dark horses from Fiji and Argentina. Led by the dynamic duo of Michael Cheika and Philippe Conteponi, these teams have been honing their set pieces and building up their team spirit - they could pose a real threat. Plus, Jackman shares his unique insights into Ireland's strategy, player fitness, and the roles of key stars. Whether you're a die-hard rugby fan or new to the sport, you won't want to miss our in-depth preview of Ireland's games, a spotlight on their strengths, and our predictions on opponents' tactics. Tune in to fully support Ireland during the World Cup.

Bernard is someone that would be well known to many people as a well loved and respected rugby player for Ireland and Leinster Connacht and the Sale Sharks, a coach for teams including FC, Grenoble and the Cardiff Dragons, as well as a writer, broadcaster and pundit, an Irish, UK and French media.
